decisions.reason: Having remained in the portfolio after launch, the coolant pressure booster system still fits the firm's core coolant-management knowledge and can be improved through existing engineering, service feedback and in-house R&D.
The coolant cleaning centrifuge is highly related to the firm's filtration and process-media capabilities, so the firm is well placed to learn from use cases and refine it rather than withdraw it.
Coolant nozzles are a strongly complementary, modular extension of the established coolant business, making them easy for the firm to absorb, adapt and retain.

The scraper belt chip conveyor is somewhat less central than coolant products but remains close enough to the conveying portfolio that a large machinery firm with broad engineering capabilities would usually keep and iterate it.
The magnetic belt chip conveyor builds directly on existing chip-handling and conveying know-how, so continued market presence and customer learning support keeping it in the range.
The hinged belt chip conveyor is closely related to the firm's conveyor and automation systems, and in a growing industry the firm is more likely to refine such a product than exit it quickly.
